name: insecure-dir-acl-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): creates $DIR_PATH and grants Everyone full control with inheritance -- the directory analog of insecure-file-acl-win (FTP roots, upload drops). Vars: DIR_PATH (required). Pairs with ftp_root_acl_restricted and similar directory-ACL sweeps. Idempotent.
script:
if (-not $DIR_PATH) { throw 'DIR_PATH is required' }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $DIR_PATH | Out-Null
icacls $DIR_PATH /grant 'Everyone:(OI)(CI)(F)' | Out-Null
Write-Output "directory ACL opened: $DIR_PATH"
